origin.description: recycle0 true and any empty argument returns character(0) when collapse is NULL, and an empty string otherwise.
origin.usage: paste(..., sep = " ", collapse = NULL, recycle0 = FALSE)

arguments.name: sep
arguments.text: Placed between values. Must be one string.

arguments.name: collapse
arguments.text: Placed between the results. NULL leaves them separate.

arguments.name: recycle0
arguments.text: Return an empty result when any argument is empty.

origin.details: Other calls follow base paste: a zero-length argument is recycled as an empty string, and NA is the text NA.
origin.example:
bp_paste <- getFromNamespace("paste", "backports")
print(bp_paste(letters[1:3], character(), collapse = NULL, recycle0 = TRUE))
print(bp_paste(c("a", NA), "b", collapse = "|"))
